content: We build our model based on PDTB-style discourse relation parsing since PDTB has a relatively simpler text segmentation method; for explicit discourse relations, it finds the presence of discourse connectives within a document and extracts discourse arguments which parametrize the connective while for implicit relations, it considers all adjacent sentences as candidate discourse arguments.
